svg.title: Spectracs — monitored capture: ONE view object, two surfaces

g.text: Spectracs — monitored capture: ONE view object, two surfaces
1 · does this role get a monitor? (the ONLY role gate in the whole path)
⇒ None means today's plain burst, unchanged
evaluator=its own ClearingEvaluator) and hands it over.
⛔ Nothing calls back INTO the plugin during the run.
PRODUCT = stop at the read (the bench / wizard)
DIAGNOSTIC = keep observing to a fixed 20-min arc
the answer is LATCHED at the read (§14.6).
2 · the run — the host pumps, the plugin decides
__frameSpectrum(image) 'the SAME per-frame reduction as the burst path
onRow(row, monitor) '~2 s throttle: status bar + live spectrum
⚠ DUCK-TYPED SEAM, not an SDK method:
⛔ A diagnostic must never break the capture
it documents — a raise prints one line.
⇒ §27.13a: declare it on the SDK base class.
⭐ Renders the very objects now on the step.
⛔ The panel builds NO copy of its own —
that duplication is what made a report-only
⛔ No role, label or step-kind is matched anywhere.
-> visitTabGroup prints only the FLAGGED children
isShownInReport is honoured at EVERY depth,
3 pages -> 1 page, 0 curve axes, summary intact.
⛔ The filter NEVER prunes the view object —
the panel renders the SAME TabGroupView (Z1).
⭐ D4: a sectioned phase is headed per STEP,
has a default on ReportableView and round-trips
through TabGroupView ⇒ a re-measure inside a
RELOADED run replaces rather than appends.
⭐ And the tabs come back on re-open because
reloaded step falls past the capture branch into
the passive visitor (§27.13d) — no longer an
accident: pinned by a test, explained in
